summary: Explains how to enable and use GPU Lightmass to bake static/stationary lighting into lightmaps on the GPU via DXR, including Full Bake vs Bake What You See modes, panel settings (GI samples, irradiance caching, denoiser), multi-GPU setup, and a feature support table.
gotchas: Beta feature
Requires DirectX 12 default RHI and Support Hardware Ray Tracing (ray-tracing capable GPU)
Whole scene must fit in GPU memory at highest-quality LOD; heavy loads can cause GPU TDR crashes
No support for World Position Offset, Pixel Depth Offset, Stationary Sky Light, lighting channels or Swarm distributed builds

summary: Step-by-step example building a Deformer Graph asset that twists a Skeletal Mesh at runtime using a Custom Compute Kernel written in HLSL, wiring Skeletal Mesh Component Binding, Skinned Mesh, Scene Data and Write Skinned Mesh nodes.
gotchas: Beta feature
Requires enabling the Deformer Graph plugin and restarting the editor
Kernel input/output pins must be added in the Details panel before writing HLSL; Save and Compile to see results

summary: Hub page introducing Geometry Scripting, a plugin of function libraries for generating and editing mesh geometry from Blueprints and Python, usable in Editor Utility Widgets, Asset Actions and Actor Blueprints.
gotchas: Beta feature

summary: Explains how Niagara stores particle positions as tile-relative Position types for Large World Coordinates, how to disable LWC per project or per system, and how to update HLSL, custom modules, Export Particle, material bindings, data interfaces and renderers.
gotchas: Beta feature
Setting Particles.Position to a fixed value in HLSL no longer works with LWC
Auto-inserted Position/Vector convert nodes ignore the tile offset and can lose precision outside the origin tile
Positions exported to material dynamic parameters lose tile offset; use Engine.Owner.LWCTile or ConvertNiagaraPositionToWorldspace

summary: Sets up the LiveLinkXR plugin to stream Vive Tracker, controller and HMD transforms through SteamVR/OpenXR into Live Link, map subjects to actors with BP_LiveLinkXR_DataHandler, calibrate the tracking origin, and use trackers without an HMD.
gotchas: Beta feature
Only supports OpenXR; SteamVR must be running and set as the OpenXR runtime
Without -xrtrackingonly, devices only appear in VR Preview or VR Editor mode
HMD-less tracker workaround is unsupported by Valve, HTC or Epic

summary: Describes the Blueprint/C++ MetaSound Builder API for creating and editing MetaSound Sources and Patches procedurally: builder subsystems, node/vertex handles, adding interfaces and nodes, connecting, removing, live auditioning, and exporting to assets.
gotchas: Beta feature; Live Updates during audition are beta
Builder API does not support variables; paged inputs/graphs have limited support
Never serialize node/vertex handles; IDs can change
Modifying serialized assets via the MetaSound Editor Subsystem works only in editor builds; Blueprint API cannot add template nodes like reroutes

summary: Tutorial in the First Person template building two MetaSound Sources: a spatialized looping bomb sound triggered to explode from the projectile Blueprint, and a stereo procedural wind whose gain is driven by pawn speed via Set Float Parameter.
gotchas: Beta feature
Requires First Person template with Starter Content
Remove the UE.Source.OneShot interface for persistent sounds like ambience or music

summary: Overview of the MIDI Device Support plugin for sending and receiving streamed MIDI messages with Blueprint, covering output device setup and Note On/Off sends, input delegates, and Sound Utilities conversion functions.

Get MIDI Output Device ID by Name
Assign To On MIDI Note On

Only streamed MIDI is supported; reading MIDI files is not
Cache the MIDI device controller in a variable or it may be garbage collected

summary: Reference of every Modeling Mode tool by category (Create, Select, Xform, Deform, Model, Mesh, Voxel, Bake, UVs, Attribs, Misc) with one-line descriptions, e.g. CubeGrid blockout, Boolean, Simplify, AutoUV, LOD Manager, Mesh To Collision.

Select tools need Mesh Element Select enabled in Modeling Mode Quick Settings
Bake tools require source and target meshes to overlap
Insert Loop only works across quads

summary: Explains how nDisplay launches decide whether to reuse a local Multi-User server and session, create a new one, or ignore a network server, with a connection-logic flowchart.
gotchas: Beta feature
If the editor is not already in an nDisplay multi-user session, a network server is ignored and a new local server is launched

summary: Hub page for the Online Services plugin, linking to its overview, interfaces (Achievements, Auth, Commerce, Leaderboards, Lobbies, Sessions, Stats, etc.), setup guides, EOS configuration and debugging console commands.
gotchas: Beta feature

summary: Introduces Remote Control, a web server inside Unreal that accepts HTTP and WebSocket requests to call Blueprint/Python-exposed functions and read/write properties or Remote Control Preset values from external apps.
gotchas: Beta feature
Disabled by default in packaged projects and -game; enable with -RCWebControlEnable -RCWebInterfaceEnable

summary: Shows how to use the StillRenderSetupAutomation Editor Utility Widget to create single-frame Level Sequences for each Cine Camera Actor and batch-render stills through Movie Render Queue, with override settings for output folder, resolution and sample counts.
keys: Automatically Add Jobs to Movie Queue
gotchas: Beta feature
Requires Show Engine Content and Show Plugin Content to find the tool
Set Engine Warm Up to at least 60 so textures load fully

summary: Shows how to register an EditorUtilityObject Blueprint or Editor Utility Widget as a startup object so the editor calls its Run function each time the project opens, configured via StartupObjects in DefaultEditorPerProjectUserSettings.ini, plus binding to editor events such as Import Subsystem.
gotchas: Beta feature
Object paths must start with /Game/ and repeat the object name after a period
Startup objects can only bind to objects that exist at startup; bindings are lost if the bound object leaves memory (bind to subsystems)

summary: Overview of the Scriptable Tools Editor Mode plugin for building modal interactive editor tools in Blueprint: tool base classes, settings, setup/tick/shutdown/HUD events, drawing API, TRS gizmos, messaging, property sets and watchers, input behaviors, and how they differ from Editor Utility Widgets.
gotchas: Beta feature
UScriptableClickDragTool is deprecated (existing tools still work)
Tools are modal and auto-shut down before save, level change or PIE; custom tool builder conditions run every tick and can slow the editor
Only one warning message displays at a time; property set UI cannot be customized in Blueprint

summary: Explains how to create AssetActionUtility or ActorActionUtility Editor Utility Blueprints whose Call In Editor functions appear under a Scripted Actions right-click menu for selected assets or actors, including restricting to Supported Classes and prompting for dynamic inputs.
gotchas: Beta feature
Custom Event nodes need Call In Editor checked manually
Without Supported Classes, actor actions appear for every actor class
Editor validates input types but not that values are set; scripts must validate inputs

summary: Explains how to move per-class constant Actor properties into a shared Sparse Class Data USTRUCT in C++ to cut memory, with criteria for candidate properties, the SparseClassDataTypes specifier, _DEPRECATED fields and a MoveDataToSparseClassDataStruct override.
gotchas: Beta feature
Requires C++; Blueprint-declared variables must move to C++
Properties with EditAnywhere, EditInstanceOnly or BlueprintReadWrite, or modified in C++, are not eligible
Direct C++ accesses must be replaced with UHT-generated getters

summary: Covers Template Sequence and Camera Animation Sequence assets that hold reusable Sequencer animation bound to an Actor class, applying them via a Template Sequence track in Level Sequences with Property Multipliers, or at runtime with Create Template Sequence Player.
gotchas: Beta feature
Only one Actor can be bound; target Actor class must match the bound class
Actors must be bound as Spawnables
Sections must use Additive, Relative or Additive from Base blend type for additive results

summary: Full guide to the UMG Viewmodel (MVVM) plugin: creating Viewmodels in Blueprint or C++ with FieldNotify variables/functions and broadcast macros, adding them to widgets with creation types (Create Instance, Manual, Global Viewmodel Collection, Property Path), and configuring View Bindings, bind directions and conversion functions.
gotchas: Beta feature; requires the UMG Viewmodel plugin
In C++ FieldNotify broadcasts must be called manually; custom Getters/Setters should not be UFUNCTIONs
Arrays are not directly accessible; write FieldNotify add/remove/get functions and notify on changes
Rebinding a Viewmodel in the Details panel after using the View Bindings menu can invalidate the binding

summary: Describes Datasmith Runtime Blueprint nodes for loading .udatasmith files into a cooked application via a DatasmithRuntimeActor, setting import options (hierarchy, collision, metadata), and opening Datasmith Direct Link connections at runtime.
gotchas: Beta feature
Officially supported on Windows and macOS; Linux is experimental
Load File from Explorer works only on Windows at runtime
Tesselation Options input is currently unused

summary: Overview of Datasmith Direct Link for pushing incremental scene updates from a source DCC/CAD app with a Datasmith Exporter plugin into Unreal or Twinmotion, including enabling it in packaged builds with -messaging.
keys: Use Less CPU when in Background
gotchas: Beta feature
Packaged projects need the -messaging command-line parameter to enable UDP messaging

summary: Explains connecting several iOS devices running the Live Link VCAM app to multiple Virtual Camera Actors in one project, and setting unique Streamer IDs and target viewports per camera.
gotchas: Beta feature
Maximum four hardware-encoded streams (one per editor viewport); extras fall back to software encoding
Streamer IDs must be unique or connections may fail
Requires supported iOS devices on a shared network

summary: Explains running PCG nodes on the GPU as compute graphs: the Custom HLSL node (kernel types, pin setup, HLSL Source Editor, debugging, examples), GPU Static Mesh Spawner procedural instancing and its limits, supported GPU nodes, Compute Sources, data labels, landscape height and grass-map sampling, and virtual texture priming.
gotchas: Beta feature; GPU Static Mesh Spawner and FastGeo componentless spawning are Experimental
GPU-spawned instances are not saved and do not support collision/physics, navigation, ray tracing, distance field lighting, baked lighting or HLOD
CPU-GPU data transfers are costly; group GPU nodes and minimize uploads/downloads
Weighted selector needs well-initialized point Seeds (e.g. ComputeSeedFromPosition) or instances may go missing; virtual textures must be primed before sampling

summary: Guide to the Waveform Editor plugin for viewing and non-destructively editing Sound Wave assets in-editor: Trim Fade, markers and loop regions (FSoundWaveCuePoint), Normalize, Fade curves, export/reimport with cue/smpl chunks, LUFS/SamplePeakDB analysis, commandlets and shortcuts.

Each transformation can appear once per Sound Wave, in a fixed order
smpl chunk loop count is ignored on import; exporting with Start Time past a cue marker sets that marker's Frame Position to 0
ResaveSoundWaveLoudness may fail to save checked-in files under source control without -AutoCheckOut

summary: Overview of WaveTable Bank assets for wavetable synthesis in MetaSounds: the WaveTable Bank Editor, bank properties (Sample Mode, Bipolar, Curve Type) and the WaveTable generator, envelope and utility MetaSound nodes.

WaveTable Player expects a Fixed Sample Rate bank; WaveTable Oscillator and WaveTable Envelope expect Fixed Resolution banks

summary: Tutorial creating a Fixed Resolution and a Fixed Sample Rate WaveTable Bank and a looping MetaSound Source that plays sine tables with WaveTable Player and modulates gain with a blended WaveTable Envelope driven by a TableIndex input.
gotchas: Beta feature
Remove the UE.Source.OneShot interface for looping sounds
